The '''Cortilium Major system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] in the [[Eucer sector/Legends|Eucer sector]] of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] that contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cortilium Major]].
